units.source_text: 这时，一只黑狗混在正月之夜的杂沓的人群中。

en.t: At that moment, a black dog was mingling with the disorderly crowd on New Year's night.

units.source_text: 这黑长毛狮子狗似乎很习惯在这种人群中穿梭，

en.t: This black, long-haired spaniel seemed very used to weaving through crowds like this,

units.source_text: 从美貌女人的大衣之间、从混有穿着军大衣的行人的脚边，伶俐地拥来挤去，在各个商店门前转悠。

en.t: cleverly pushing its way between the coats of beautiful women and around the feet of passersby in military overcoats, loitering in front of one shop after another.

units.source_text: 它在圣护院八桥的一家昔日专卖名糕点的店铺门前嗅着味儿。

en.t: It was sniffing in front of a Shogoin Yatsuhashi shop that in former days had sold only famous sweets.

units.source_text: 店铺灯火通明，这时我才看清狗的脸，

en.t: The shop was brightly lit, and only then did I make out the dog's face,

units.source_text: 它的一只眼睛已经溃烂，聚在溃烂了的眼睛的眼角上的眼屎和血迹，就像玛瑙；

en.t: one of its eyes had already festered, and the mucus and traces of blood gathered at the corner of the ruined eye looked like agate;

units.source_text: 另一只健全的眼睛盯着地面。

en.t: its other, healthy eye was fixed on the ground.

units.source_text: 这长毛狮子狗的脊背上带有一块烫伤的伤疤，结成一束成团的硬毛，格外显眼。

en.t: On the back of this long-haired spaniel was a burn scar, where a clump of hard, matted hair had formed and stood out conspicuously.
